Message:
I cannot save the world alone.
However, with borrowed power,
it becomes a different story.

Strike down evil...with evil.
As long as I have
the resolve to do that...

...I know you can hear me.
I want you to grant me
the power to eradicate demons.

—Heh heh heh.
You dare to tell me, a demon,
to eradicate other demons?

Ever the arrogant one, you are.
But, very well. As payment,
I will have you surrender
your greatest desire...

I offer you my soul.
And after I die,
you and I will fall together
into the depths of Hell.

—Ahh, I see.
It’s clear to me
what you’re trying to do.
I dwell within you,
so I can see through
every last naïve idea of yours.

—Then I shall be
so kind as to tell you...
The abyss where demons
fall is an eternal prison,
confining its prisoners
until the end of the world.

It is a hell of wailing agony—
enough to make
even demons scream.
Your final hour will indeed
be a wretched one.

I know...
I am aware of everything...
that awaits me.

—Haah-hah-hah-hah!
Oh, how sweet will
the screams of arrogance be
once they escape a soul so noble!

When that pride of yours is
ripped away, I look forward
to savoring the symphony
of your screams.

The very thought makes me
tremble with ecstasy!
HAAH-HAH-HAH-HAH!

He will not refuse
even a contract that
brings about his own demise.
Because this demon is a demon.
And, because he holds
dominion over what I need.

The one poison
that can kill demons.
The poison called...“Arrogance.”

—Our contract is sealed.
I give you my power
of Arrogance.
Here, take it.

The mark of the contract
was then carved into my body,
and a sinister black presence
began to overflow from within me.
